sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, coalesce(o.strategy,'-') AS c2, o.market_ticker AS c3, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS c4, o.limit_price::text AS c5, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS c6, coalesce(o.cancel_reason,'-') AS c7 FROM live_orders o WHERE o.created_at > now() - interval '14 hours' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 25) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, max(q.captured_at)::text, 'lastqtick', o2.market_ticker, coalesce(o2.status,'-'), count(*)::text, min(q.captured_at)::text, '-' FROM live_order_queue_ticks q JOIN live_orders o2 ON o2.id = q.live_order_id WHERE o2.strategy = 'Alimm1' GROUP BY o2.market_ticker, o2.status)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
